prompt.note: DeepSite generated the page from a prompt. The evidence is the Space tag, badge, and commit messages. That is publisher-side artifact evidence, not a victim agent log.

space.note: The generated site is published as a Hugging Face Space at a *.hf.space hostname. 29 of 42 pages carry deepsite/deepsite-v3.

page.note: The pages are fake logins. One Microsoft page posts email, password, phone, and date of birth, then redirects to Outlook. Prompts also ask to hide the page from crawlers.

steal.note: Credentials, OTPs, and card data went to Telegram bots, Discord webhooks, or form services. The profile covers the outbound post, not a specific bot token.

down.note: Aikido reported the pages on 16 October 2026 and says Hugging Face paused or removed all 42 by 29 October 2026. Takedown is not a detection gap on the victim.
